paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua Uzaa: Rabbi Yochanan said, ‘Yehoshua Uzaa asked,’ and so forth; Rabbi Yochanan also said, ‘Rabbi Yehoshua Uzaa subsequently resolved it’: Yoma 47b. Hoshia is given with the siglum ס״ד [provisionally an alternative-reading formula]. In Nedarim 38b: ‘Yehoshua of Uza says.’
